intake.description: Gold bangles and a necklace were discovered missing from a steel cupboard in the bedroom without signs of forced entry. A police complaint was filed regarding the missing items valued at approximately Rs 1,50,000.
intake.severity_reason: The estimated loss is between Rs 50,000 and Rs 4,99,999.

route.reason: policy number PRP-26-27718 has prefix for property; intake agent read the email as property

citations.quote: We pay for contents stolen, and damage to the home caused, during a theft involving forcible and violent entry into the home, subject to PROP-EXC-4.4 and PROP-CON-5.2.
We do not pay for theft or disappearance of contents where there is no sign of forcible and violent entry into the home.

coverage.reasoning: The claimant reported the theft of gold jewelry from a steel cupboard without any signs of forced entry. According to policy clause PROP-EXC-4.4, thefts without signs of forcible and violent entry are explicitly excluded from coverage. Therefore, the claim is not covered.

reasons: all citations verified against the clause text; outputs passed validation first time
